goal: A worker cycle that hits a transient store fault which then clears completes without incrementing the consecutive-cycle-failure breaker.

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the consecutive_failures breaker and CYCLE_FAILURE_BACKOFF (~line 2117); the transient retry must absorb the fault BENEATH this breaker so a cleared transient costs no strike
constraints: transient_not_breaker: a cycle hitting a transient store fault that then clears must complete with the worker's consecutive_failures counter at 0 -- proving the retry happened at the fault site below the breaker, not at the breaker level
Do not 'handle' the fault by catching it at the breaker (which still spends a strike and backs off the whole cycle); the transient retry from sqlite-store-retry must do the work first
A permanent stop (from schema-mismatch-permanent-stop) must still short-circuit the breaker as a single distinctly-labelled exit
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under tests/ except adding the named test; do not weaken existing worker tests
Do not change the meaning of the breaker for genuine repeated cycle failures (a real non-transient cycle failure still counts a strike)
edge_cases: Catching the transient at the breaker level (counter increments to 1 then resets) must fail the counter-at-0 assertion
A genuine non-transient cycle failure must still increment the breaker
